answer_1.quote: This study introduces Model-based Preference Optimization (MPO), a novel approach to improve the faithfulness and quality of abstractive summaries generated by Large Language Models (LLMs).

answer_2.quote: We adopt the evaluation protocol proposed by . They categorized the evaluation into three key divisions: Faithfulness, Relevance (with the source), and Similarity (with the target).

answer_4.quote: To assess whether the automatic score (i.e., AlignScore) aligns with human preference, we conducted human evaluations on 100 samples from the TL;DR dataset across two groups.
answer_4.guideline: Group A: AlignScore of DPO ≤ 0.5 and AlignScore of MPO > 0.5; Group B: AlignScore of DPO > 0.5 and AlignScore of MPO ≤ 0.5
